title: Coinbase Crypto Forum | Closing Remarks
description:
At Coinbase, our mission is to create an open financial system for the world.

This inaugural Crypto Forum, hosted by Coinbase, brings visionaries, policymakers, and financial leaders together in London to define Europe’s role in the quickly growing global digital asset industry.

✅ Subscribe to our channel here: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCofTOFX4QuhT8OY-3-fFRFw/?sub_confirmation=1

#coinbase #Crypto #Blockchain 

__

This content is being provided to you for informational purposes only. Nothing discussed in this video is intended to be investment advice. This content, and any information contained therein, does not constitute a recommendation by Coinbase to buy, sell or hold any security, financial product or instrument referenced in the content.

asr.full_text: How do developers make their impact through policy? Andrew Brackett I just wanted to say a big thank you to Bret & Brian for a very interesting discussion. I think Brian has been at the forefront of the thinking around market infrastructure and policy. We thank him for that in a very fitting way to end today, which has been hugely rich in content. end today which has been hugely rich in content and i think it's very clear from some of the policy um and the uh the sessions sorry that we've had uh that you know i think europe is at the forefront uh of the next chapter of crypto policy um the foundations have been laid you know institution participations here regulatory momentums here not quite where we want it to be, but it's getting there. And we certainly have the expertise to deliver. And a lot of you are sitting here in this room. But now is the time to action. We've seen that from the EU, delivering Mika, and certainly the UK has an opportunity now to take the good bits from the EU and the US and deliver a foundation and a framework that can allow us to, or firms to, invest and create growth in this sector. And so I think we're all excited about that. We all know clear frameworks create growth, and that's what we hope we can achieve through a collective conversation. So thank you all, to our clients, our partners, and the media today for helping us with that conversation. I also want to say a big thank you to everyone who's been involved in making today a really success. In particular, Michaela and Emily. I don't know where – if Emily's around there as well. So, if you can all give a lot of hard work and late nights and a lot of people involved. But without those, too, I don't think we could have had such a successful day. And look, there's plenty of Coinbase and Deribit team, who are now part of Coinbase, obviously, around to have conversations. We've got drinks until 5.30 today. So we'd love to continue the rich conversations that we've already had. Please do engage.
